title: [GMCP 203.032.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Transport, origin, SSRF, DNS, and endpoint security
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-032-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: Network policy validates every URL and redirect, resolves and pins permitted addresses, blocks private/link-local/metadata reachability unless explicitly granted, detects DNS rebinding, enforces host/origin/TLS and certificate rules, and separates proxy trust zones. Localhost impersonation, rebinding, redirect chains, request smuggling, header confusion, downgrade and egress-bypass suites fail closed. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
